cards.text: We're near the end of John's first letter, and he's just said whoever has the Son has life. Now he tells his readers why he has written these things. Friend, that's a line I'd underline, highlight AND stick on the fridge.

cards.question: John writes to those who believe in the name of the Son of God. Why does he say he wrote these things?

answers.text: So they know they have eternal life
So they can answer false teachers
So they will write back to him soon

cards.text: Next, John talks about the confidence believers have before God when they ask Him for something. REAL confidence, friend, not me yelling "PICK ME" every time somebody opened the junk drawer looking for tape.

cards.question: John says God hears believers when they ask Him for anything. But asked how?
True or false: John says that if we know God hears us in whatever we ask, we know we already possess what we have asked of Him.

cards.text: Now John pictures a believer watching his brother commit a sin not leading to death. Most of us would start typing in the group chat, but John points somewhere else.

cards.question: When a believer sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, what does John say he should do?

cards.text: John says God will give life to those who commit that kind of sin, but then he adds there IS a sin that leads to death. He doesn't spell out what it is, and this old stamper is NOT adding his own ingredients to the recipe.

cards.question: True or false: John says a believer should ask God regarding the sin that leads to death.
John wraps up the thought: All unrighteousness is ___, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.

cards.text: Now John says "we know" three times in a row, like a man underlining the same sentence until the pen runs dry. First, anyone born of God does not keep on sinning.

cards.question: Anyone born of God isn't left on his own. John says the One who was born of God ___ him.
True or false: John says the evil one cannot touch the one born of God.

cards.text: Second, John says we know that we are of God. Then he looks at the rest of the world, and friend, it's a whole different story.

cards.question: What does John say the whole world is under?

answers.text: The power of the evil one

cards.text: Third, John says we know the Son of God has come. I waited YEARS in a junk drawer for somebody to come get me, so give me a minute with this one, friend.

cards.question: John says the Son of God has come and has given us ___, so that we may know Him who is true.
True or false: John says believers are in Him who is true, in His Son Jesus Christ, and that He is the true God and eternal life.

cards.text: Right after calling Jesus the true God and eternal life, John writes his very last line. It's SHORT, like the final text you send before your phone hits one percent.

cards.question: John calls his readers little children one last time. What does he tell them to keep themselves from?
